Unassuming yet impressively authentic, opposite Pham Ngu Lao backpackers' area
Feb 2026 • Family
Wanted to try authentic German cuisine and read good reviews of this restaurant.

Small, unassuming with simple wooden tables and chairs, not much decor except a small picture of a German town (maybe of where the owner is from?), but I guess the view of the Saigon Central Park opposite is enough to put you in a chill mood. Seeing two other tables of German regulars kinda confirmed this place's authenticity. Though small, the servers here were professional and helped us set up the table properly.

The menu had surprisingly numerous options so we went with the hits - Bratwurst with Rosti, Schnitzel, Cordon bleu and Goulash. Portions were good, and though fried, they weren't oily. Good prices for authentic and comforting, rather healthy German food.

Right across the road/Central Park from the backpackers' Pham Ngu Lao area in District 1 heart of town, but this side of the road felt a lot quieter, so I think it won't be hard for taxis stopping right outside, or for motorbikes to park in the evenings.

Top German beer selection available
Apr 2023 • Solo
Descent bar and restaurant for good selection of German imported beer(very important) and food menu looks excellent too but did not eat this time. Comfortable inside area with a seated bar area at the back, music playing in the background which allows one to one conversions. To be honest why drink Heineken or Tiger when you have imported German Arco Weizen and Arco Urfass on draught and bottled Hofbrau Munchner in bottles also imported from Germany. Always worth paying more for quality beer. I am actually drinking Veldensteiner Schwarzbier black lager which is excellent as I have never drunk this beer before and does not disappoint when it enters my mouth. Location of Parkhaus is only a slow 20 minute walk away from the river and Don Khoi Street. This drinking and eating establishment is located in the so called backpackers area of Ho Chi Minh (Saigon) Bui Vien Streetwere where there is a gold mine of cheap hotels and restaurants. Undoubtedly after cycling in the city in 34c temperatures one does get thursty but not for water. Thankfully inside Parkhaus the inside temperature is very sensible as their air conditioning is set to a healthy condition. There is nothing worse then being outside in 34-37c temperatures and going into a place of very cold, ice box air conditioning, for me it is very uncomfortable but here it was very comfortable. Have to recommend Parkhaus on the beer and obviously will have to return to try the food.
